resources.string: Arrange time, date, notifications, widget and battery information for each screen and orientation
Restore this layout to system default

Full-screen preview uses real widget content. Select a module to drag it or resize it with the bottom-right handle. Hide controls to inspect the result; Fine adjust provides precise percentages. Save applies all four drafts; Back discards them. Native date, notifications and battery information show current system content. Actual AOD screen brightness and burn-in movement are controlled by the system.
